criteria.requirement: Add Paragraph.add_hyperlink(text,address="",fragment="",style=None) and Hyperlink address/fragment/text setters plus remove(). Build real OOXML runs/relationships, support external URI and internal bookmark links without fetching addresses. Text replacement retains first-run formatting, removes extra text runs only; unchanged other paragraph content. Validate strings and nonempty target before adding side effects. Editing/removing drops an old relationship only according to its BEFORE-change reference count, retaining shared links and deduplicated targets. Save/reopen external URL/fragment/internal targets and formatting; no automatic bookmark creation or Word page rendering.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
